Sister Zheng got straight to the point: "Xiulan, our community's 'Neighborhood Handicraft Corner' will officially start classes next Wednesday, from 2 p.m. to 4 p.m. every Wednesday. We'd like to formally invite you to volunteer as an instructor, mainly teaching basic embroidery to some of the elderly sisters and young mothers in our community. The community will provide a monthly subsidy of 200 yuan for transportation and materials as a token of appreciation for your efforts—it's not much, but it's a gesture of gratitude." Sister Zheng continued with praise: "Your skills are well-known to everyone, and you're so patient. You're the perfect person for this role!" Ma Xiulan felt both surprised and delighted, with a hint of nervousness, but sensing the sincerity and trust, she didn’t hesitate much and nodded with a smile: "Sister Zheng, thank you to the community and you for thinking so highly of me. I’ll take on this role and do my best!" After seeing Sister Zheng off to the elevator, Ma Xiulan returned to the living room, her heart still pounding. She took a few sips of tea and looked at the invitation letter and schedule Sister Zheng had left on the coffee table. A sense of fulfillment from being recognized welled up inside her.

She flipped to a page with the pattern of "Lotus and Carp" (symbolizing abundance year after year), finding it festive and auspicious, and lightly traced its outline on the paper with her pencil. 

Not content with just thinking on her own, Ma Xiulan picked up her phone. First, she sent a voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, sharing the good news of becoming a counselor and asking, "Chunmei, what do you think about me embroidering 'Lotus and Carp' for the market at the end of the month? Or should I embroider the character 'Fu' (fortune)?" Chunmei replied quickly, and the two chatted via voice messages for over ten minutes. Chunmei suggested adding some gold thread to make it more eye-catching. 

Next, Ma Xiulan messaged her skillful neighbor Zhou Xiuqin, who replied that the pattern was great and reminded her that next year is the Year of the Snake, so she could consider adding related elements. However, Ma Xiulan felt unfamiliar with snake-shaped embroidery and preferred to stick with traditional auspicious patterns.

After seeing him enter the school gate, she rides back home alone. Afternoon: Ma Xiulan rides her electric scooter to pick up the second son Ma Mingzhe from primary school, then together they go to the kindergarten to pick up the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin. Finally, she rides home with both children, asking about their day at school along the way.

name: Housework Organization and Rest Connection
description: After sending her child to school, Ma Xiulan returned home to do her morning chores, including washing dishes, wiping down the stove, doing laundry in the washing machine, and cleaning the living room. After finishing the housework, starting at 09:00, she spread a tablecloth on the dining table in the living room and focused on preparing materials for tomorrow’s community handicraft corner teaching session. She divided embroidery needles, colored threads, fabric pieces, and pattern drawings into eight sets, while also ironing the fabric for the 10 pairs of coaster orders that community worker Zheng Xiuying had delivered yesterday. Once completed, she took photos and sent them to the community handicraft corner’s WeChat group for confirmation. During breaks, she drank water, rested, stretched her shoulders and neck, called her mother to check in, and sent a WeChat message to her husband to ask if he would be home for dinner, once again mentioning the parent-teacher meeting.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Community, at home

name: Preparation for Manual Teaching and Advancement of Embroidery Orders
description: This is an all-day personal craft activity. In the morning, preparations were made for tomorrow's community craft corner teaching session, including dividing 8 sets of teaching materials (embroidery needles, colored threads, fabric pieces, pattern drawings) and ironing fabric for 10 pairs of coaster orders. After completion, confirmation was sent in the WeChat group. In the afternoon, by the window with good lighting, focus was placed on advancing embroidery orders. A pair of coasters embroidered with the character "福" (fortune) was selected for pattern drawing, framing, and outlining the main border with backstitch embroidery, immersing in the tranquility of craftsmanship. The evening was interrupted by picking up the child and preparing dinner. At night, after chatting with the husband, the finishing touches were completed on the "福" character coaster from the afternoon under the desk lamp, steadily progressing with the orders.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Community, Living Room at Home

name: Market Procurement and Neighborhood Socializing
description: After checking the weather (sunny turning cloudy with strong winds), Ma Xiulan changed into a thick down jacket, picked up her shopping list and basket, and walked about 16 minutes to her regular vegetable market, Tai'an Shengshijun. At the familiar stall of Aunt Sun Guifang, she bought potatoes, cabbage, tomatoes, and other items. Aunt Sun warmly greeted her and gave her some coriander as a gift. Later, she also purchased minced pork, pork liver, and vinegar. While shopping, she coincidentally ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan, and the two chatted about Baduanjin exercises. Due to the strong wind outside, Wang Guilan kindly invited Ma Xiulan to her home for tea and a more detailed conversation. The two walked about 5 minutes to Wang Guilan’s home (No. 158 Jingwen Road). In Wang Guilan’s living room, they enjoyed jasmine tea, mung bean cakes, and sunflower seeds while chatting happily, moving from Baduanjin to topics like children’s education and community news. Mindful of her weight, Ma Xiulan only ate one mung bean cake. After nearly an hour, Ma Xiulan declined the invitation to stay for dinner, picked up her groceries, and walked about 10 minutes back home.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Yuewei Road Taian Shengshijun Vegetable Market, Tianjin Jinghai District Jingwen Road No. 158 Wang Guilan's home and related commuting roads

name: Lunch Preparation and Midday Break
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan sorted and stored the purchased ingredients in the kitchen. She soaked the pork liver in clean water, seasoned the minced pork for later use, and set aside the leftover rice, planning to make fried rice with eggs the next morning. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, came home at noon, and Ma Xiulan quickly prepared tomato and egg noodles for lunch. During the meal, Ma Zhiqiang mentioned that the parent-teacher meeting might be held next week, though the school had not yet issued an official notice. After the meal, her husband helped with the dishes. Once the kitchen was tidied up, Ma Xiulan leaned back on the living room sofa, closed her eyes, and rested for twenty minutes, taking a short afternoon nap.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Community, kitchen, dining room, and living room at home.

location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Community, at home

name: Evening Family Time and Dinner
description: After picking up the children from school, Ma Xiulan urged her second son to finish his homework and gave her youngest daughter drawing brushes to keep her occupied. She then tied on an apron and began preparing dinner in the kitchen, which included stir-fried spinach with pork liver, cabbage and pork meatball soup, and stir-fried shredded potatoes, while also cooking rice. Throughout the process, she occasionally checked on the children’s homework progress. At dinner time, the whole family gathered in the dining room. Ma Xiulan explained the nutritional benefits of pork liver and encouraged the children to eat more. Everyone shared updates about their day, and Ma Xiulan mentioned her teaching responsibilities for the next day, to which the children cheered her on. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, once again confirmed the details of the upcoming parent-teacher meeting.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Complex, kitchen, children's room, and dining room.

name: Evening Family Activities and Personal Rest
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan tidied up the kitchen while her husband helped the children with their homework. Once everything was in order, Ma Xiulan recorded the day’s market expenses (48.5 yuan). Then, the family watched the news and a TV drama together. Around 20:30, Ma Xiulan began supervising the three children as they took turns bathing, brushing their teeth, telling a story to her youngest daughter, and checking her sons’ alarm clocks. After the children settled quietly in their rooms, she chatted with her husband for a while, mainly about the children’s studies and parent-teacher meetings. Later, she finished the embroidery work on a coaster she had started in the afternoon. During her personal bedtime routine, she did a few shoulder and neck stretches to relieve fatigue. Before sleeping, she reflected on the day: teaching materials were prepared, groceries were well-stocked, orders were progressing, and she had pleasant conversations with her neighbors. Although she felt slightly full from the gathering earlier, overall, she experienced a sense of "prepared calm." After setting the alarm, she fell asleep feeling content and expectant.
location: No. Ruidao Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, at home in the Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu residential community.

I set the rice cooker to schedule millet porridge, took steamed buns and pickles from the refrigerator, and boiled four eggs on the stove. While preparing, I silently rehearsed the teaching steps in my mind.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Community, kitchen at home

Sister Zheng warmly takes out an envelope containing a 200-yuan cash subsidy and encourages her with a smile: "Xiulan, teach well, everyone is looking forward to learning from you! Relax, you can do it." This encouragement makes Ma Xiulan feel much more at ease.

Together with Xiao Zhao, the staff member on duty today, she arranged the tables and chairs in the activity room into a U-shape for convenient teaching observation. Then, she neatly placed the embroidery threads, fabric, needles, and patterns from her material kit on each table. As she arranged them, she silently rehearsed her opening remarks for later.

At the stall of Aunt Sun Guifang, whom she knew well, she bought three tomatoes, a handful of baby bok choy, and half a pound of eggs. Aunt Sun asked her why she was so early today, and she replied with a hint of pride that she would be teaching embroidery in the community in the afternoon. Aunt Sun praised her repeatedly for being capable. Then, she walked about 10 minutes back home with the groceries. After putting away the vegetables she had bought, she started preparing a simple lunch: boiling water for noodles while stir-frying a tomato and egg sauce. While waiting for the noodles to cook, she picked up her phone to check the community WeChat group. She saw that Sister Zheng had already posted a notice about the afternoon handicraft corner activity, and several neighbors had left comments expressing their anticipation. This added to her confidence.

After the meal, she urged Yuxin to take a short nap on the sofa. Ma Xiulan quickly tidied up the kitchen and dishes, then leaned back on the sofa herself, closing her eyes for a moment to recharge her energy for the afternoon teaching session. Afterward, she rode the electric bike again to take Yuxin back to kindergarten (about 10 minutes). The title "Teacher Ma" made her feel both a little embarrassed and added a sense of responsibility.
location: No. 16 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street Community Activity Center

name: Community Handicraft Corner Teaching Implementation
description: All the trainees had arrived, about ten or so. Ma Xiulan stood at the front. At first, her voice was a bit tense, but as she saw the friendly and expectant looks on everyone's faces, she gradually relaxed. She began by introducing herself, then hung up a pattern of the character "福" (fortune) and started demonstrating the basic running stitch, step by step, from threading the needle to tying knots. Her explanation was clear, and her technique was skillful. After the demonstration, the trainees began practicing. She walked down from the platform to guide each one individually, patiently helping two elderly aunts with presbyopia thread their needles. During the break, everyone drank tea provided by the community and chatted about embroidery and daily life, creating a lively and harmonious atmosphere.
location: No. 16 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street Community Activity Center

name: Teaching Conclusion and Feedback

location: No. 16 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street Community Activity Center and its entrance

name: Going Home Together and Sharing Experiences

I used to get it wrong when I tried to figure it out on my own, but today I understood it right away." Ma Xiulan felt warm inside and also asked Zhou Xiuqin for some insights on communicating with students of different ages. They parted ways at the intersection near the residential area.
location: While walking from the Jingwen Road No. 16 Chaoyang Street Community Activity Center to the Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Area

description: Under the living room light, I took out my notebook and carefully recorded: 1. Teaching situation: Most students have mastered the basic cast-on technique, but need to strengthen their skills in binding off; 2. Issues and solutions: Two aunties had difficulty threading needles, so I will bring two needle threaders next time; 3. Material consumption: After checking the embroidery threads, I found that navy blue and red are being used up quickly and need to be replenished. After finishing the notes, I was still excited and not sleepy at all. So I took out the unfinished coaster orders and started embroidering the second pair of "福" character coasters. However, after about half an hour of embroidery, the fatigue from the day gradually set in, and my attention began to wander.

Then, she applied homemade organic fertilizer by diluting the fermented liquid from the previous day, sprinkling it over the soil, and mixing it in lightly. Next came sowing—she dug shallow furrows as noted in her gardening journal and carefully planted tomato, cucumber, and lettuce seeds before covering them with a thin layer of soil. After that, she implemented green pest control measures by inserting homemade yellow sticky traps and spraying a solution made from soaked garlic and chili peppers. Finally, she completed the sowing and covered the soil to retain moisture, watering it thoroughly and gently spreading dry straw over the surface of the vegetable bed to keep it warm and moist. Looking at the well-tended garden, she felt a sense of anticipation.

Around 11 a.m., all ten embroidery pieces were finished, neatly stacked, and ready for delivery. Looking at the fruits of her labor, she felt a sense of steadiness and satisfaction.

Using leftover ingredients from lunch and some minced meat, I prepared noodles with gravy, paired with a cold cucumber salad made from cucumbers picked at noon. While the whole family sat together for the meal, I specifically reminded the children to pack their small backpacks early in the evening for tomorrow's outing. Due to her busy schedule and intentional effort to control her portions, Ma Xiulan ate slightly less than usual. After dinner, I tidied up the kitchen and washed the dishes.
location: At home (kitchen, dining room) in Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu residential community, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Supervising Study and Checking Homework
description: Urged the three children to complete or review their homework respectively. Focused on checking the math homework of the second son, Ma Mingzhe, and helped the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, review pinyin. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was able to complete his homework independently for the most part.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Community, at home (living room, children's bedrooms)

name: Discuss with the eldest son about the items needed for boarding at school.
description: After the children finished their homework, I confirmed with the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan (13 years old), what additional items he needed for boarding school. Ma Mingxuan mentioned that he needed a sturdier backpack and a few extracurricular books that interested him (such as science fiction novels and historical stories). Ma Xiulan noted each item in her phone's memo and told him they would go shopping together after returning from Beijing.
location: In the living room of the home at Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu residential complex, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Family Leisure and Starting to Embroider a Baby Belly Band
description: While the children were watching cartoons on TV, Ma Xiulan sat on the nearby sofa and took out her embroidery tools. Under the light, she stretched the baby bellyband cloth with the traced pattern from the previous night onto the embroidery frame and began outlining the design with a flat stitch. With the TV sound as background noise, she focused intently on her needlework, feeling calm and absorbed. Occasionally, she would look up to check on the children and remind them to keep a distance from the TV.
location: In the living room of the home at Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Community, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Urge the children to wash up and go to bed.
description: Turn off the TV and urge the three children to wash up one by one. Help the youngest daughter comb her hair, check if the second son is brushing his teeth properly, and remind the eldest son to set his alarm. Then watch as the children return to their rooms and lie down, turning off the lights one by one.
location: At home in the Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu residential community, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City (bathroom, children's bedrooms)

name: Personal Time: Reviewing Driving Test Mistakes and Washing Up
description: After completing my personal grooming, I sat in front of the dressing table in the bedroom, took out my phone, and browsed through the screenshots of the wrong questions from the morning's driving test simulation. I carefully reviewed the key points of each question and took notes on several traffic signs that are easily confused.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruhe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Community, Home (Bedroom, Bathroom)

name: Relax before bed and review the entire day.
description: Turning off the main lights and leaving only the night light on, I lay in bed reflecting on the fulfilling day: morning exercise, driving test, luggage check, successfully hosting the handicraft corner, sharing the harvest from the vegetable garden, and communicating with the children. Although it was busy, everything was completed as planned, especially with thorough preparations made for the upcoming trip. A sense of satisfaction and anticipation for tomorrow eased the fatigue, and I drifted off to sleep with a smile.
location: In the bedroom of the home at Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu residential complex, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Morning Review and Family Preparation
description: Ma Xiulan woke up early to do a last-minute review for the first subject of the driving test, then prepared a simple breakfast (steamed buns, boiled eggs, and warm milk). She woke up her children, Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin, and they had breakfast together. She reminded the children to wait at home and checked their documents and phone battery levels.
location: At home in Jinghai Zhongnan Junyue Mansion, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Subject One of the Driving Test and Sharing the Good News
description: Ma Xiulan rode an electric bike to the Vehicle Management Office in Jinghai District to take the first subject of the driving test, and passed with a score of 92. After the exam, she immediately called her son Ma Mingzhe at home to share the good news and also informed her husband Ma Zhiqiang via WeChat.
location: Vehicle Management Office of Tianjin Jinghai District Public Security Traffic Management Bureau, at the Intersection of Jingwen Road and Xuhua Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home to sort out local specialties.
description: On her way home, Ma Xiulan met her neighbor Wang Guilan at the entrance of the residential area, sharing the good news of passing the exam and having a brief conversation. After returning home, she packed her luggage with her children and prepared local specialties to bring to her sister, including pickled cucumbers, sweet garlic, and fresh tomatoes and cucumbers harvested from their small vegetable garden.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Community

name: Lunch and Pre-Departure Check
description: Ma Xiulan quickly prepared fried rice with eggs and tomato egg soup for lunch, which she enjoyed with the children. After the meal, she conducted a final luggage check, confirming the clothing, toiletries, documents, and other essentials. She then turned off unnecessary electrical appliances at home, checked the gas valve and faucets, and ensured everything was secure before locking the doors and windows.
location: At home in Jinghai Zhongnan Junyue Mansion, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Go to Tianjin South Railway Station
description: Ma Xiulan walked with the children and their luggage to the bus stop, took a bus, and then transferred to the subway to head to Tianjin South Railway Station. The entire journey took about 1 hour and 10 minutes, and the children found the subway ride quite novel along the way.
location: Tianjin South Railway Station, Liujing Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Waiting and Ticket Checking at High-Speed Railway Station
description: Upon arriving at Tianjin South Station, Ma Xiulan led the children through security, found the waiting area, and confirmed the train number and boarding gate information. During the wait, she purchased bottled water and reminded the children to stay close. When boarding began, they successfully boarded the train.
location: Tianjin South Station Waiting Hall, Liujing Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Take the high-speed train to Beijing.
description: Take the high-speed train G8912 from Tianjin to Beijing. During the journey, the children watch the scenery while Ma Xiulan distributes snacks and keeps them company. At the same time, she receives a WeChat message from her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, informing her that he is safe. After replying, she continues the journey with peace of mind.
location: During the high-speed rail journey from Tianjin South Station to Beijing South Station

name: Arriving at my sister's house for a family reunion.
description: After the high-speed train arrived at Beijing South Station, Ma Xiulan took the children to her sister's home in the Qingyiyuan community by ride-hailing. Upon arrival, they warmly reunited with her sister Ma Xiufen and her family, and presented them with Tianjin specialties. This was followed by casual family conversation, during which Ma Xiulan shared her joy about the exam results, and her sister inquired about her recent life. The two sisters then prepared dinner together and enjoyed a hearty welcoming feast (including Beijing roast duck, among other dishes). In the cheerful atmosphere, Ma Xiulan ate more than usual and felt she might have gained some weight. After dinner, she helped with clearing the dishes and continued chatting in the living room.
location: At my sister's home in Qingyi Garden Community, East-West Street, Jiugong Town, Daxing District, Beijing.

name: The children wash up and settle down.
description: Ma Xiulan took the children, Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin, to the guest room, urging them to wash up, change into their pajamas, and settle down to rest.
location: Sister's Guest Room, Qingyi Garden Community, Jiugong East-West Street, Jiugong Town, Daxing District, Beijing

name: Leisure Embroidery and Communication
description: Ma Xiulan was embroidering in the guest room, completing the color matching details of the baby bellyband. She took photos and communicated with her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin via WeChat, discussing the color matching and receiving praise.
location: The guest room at my sister's house in Qingyi Garden, Jiugong East-West Street, Jiugong Town, Daxing District, Beijing

name: Personal Hygiene and Bedtime Review
description: Ma Xiulan completed her personal hygiene routine, lay down, and reflected on the joys of the day: passing the exam, a smooth journey, and a family reunion. Thinking about tomorrow's plans and buying a backpack for her eldest son, Mingxuan, after returning home, she gradually drifted off to sleep in contentment.
location: The guest room at my sister's house in Qingyi Garden Community, Jiugong East-West Street, Jiugong Town, Daxing District, Beijing

name: Getting Up and Personal Grooming
description: Waking up in the guest room bed at my sister's house, despite the fatigue from yesterday's journey and the late-night conversation, I still felt excited about today's itinerary. I got up quietly, went through my personal morning routine, deliberately changed into a pair of comfortable flats, and checked the water bottle, tissues, and sun hat in my backpack.
location: Sister's Guest Room, Beikong Residential Area, No. 102 Wudian Road, Daxing District, Beijing

name: Assist in preparing family breakfast
description: After washing up, I went to the kitchen and saw my sister already busy. Naturally, I joined in, helping to fry eggs, heat milk, and set the table. The children from both families were gradually awakened and chattered around the dining table. Everyone sat together, enjoying simple bread, eggs, milk, and porridge in a warm atmosphere. I reminded my own children to eat more to store energy for the "intense walking" in the morning.
location: Sister's Kitchen and Dining Room, Beikong Residential Area, No. 102 Wudian Road, Daxing District, Beijing

name: Commuting to Tiananmen
description: After breakfast, everyone quickly cleared the dining table. Each child’s water bottle was filled, and their belongings were checked once more. The group locked the door and walked for about 15 minutes to Jiugong Metro Station. They then took the Yizhuang Line, transferring to Line 1 to reach Tiananmen East Station. The subway was not particularly crowded on a weekend morning. Ma Xiulan and her sister sat together chatting, while the children were fascinated by the station announcements and the lights in the tunnel. The entire commute took approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes.
location: Walk from the North Air Residential Community at No. 102 Wudian Road, Daxing District, Beijing to Jiugong Subway Station, then take the subway to Tiananmen East Station.

name: Visit Tiananmen Square
description: Stepping out of the subway station, the magnificent Tiananmen Gate Tower and the vast square came into view. My heart was filled with excitement as I saw with my own eyes the scenes I had only encountered in textbooks and on television. My sister served as a temporary tour guide, introducing landmarks such as the Monument to the People's Heroes and the Great Hall of the People. With the Tiananmen Gate Tower as the backdrop, we took numerous family and sister photos on the square, while the children ran around excitedly. After passing through the security check, we walked toward the Forbidden City.
location: Tiananmen Square, East Chang'an Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing

name: Visit the Palace Museum
description: After scanning a QR code with my phone at the Meridian Gate to purchase an electronic ticket, I entered the Forbidden City and rented an electronic audio guide. I followed the central axis to visit the Hall of Supreme Harmony, the Hall of Central Harmony, and the Hall of Preserving Harmony, marveling at the grandeur and intricacy of ancient architecture. At the Palace of Heavenly Purity, the Hall of Union, and the Palace of Earthly Tranquility, we discussed life in the ancient imperial harem. From 12:00 to 12:30 noon, I sat down in the rest area near the Imperial Garden to drink water and share some small snacks I had brought along to replenish my energy. Afterwards, I explored the Imperial Garden, admiring the ancient trees and pavilions. Exiting the Forbidden City through the Gate of Divine Might, the red walls and yellow tiles looked particularly magnificent against the blue sky. The entire visit, which included walking, listening to the audio guide, and taking breaks, lasted about four hours.
location: No. 4 Jingshan Front Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing, The Palace Museum

name: Walk to and enjoy a Peking Duck lunch.
description: Exiting the Forbidden City through the Shenwu Gate, I walked along Jingshan Front Street, Wusi Street, and other roads for about 30 minutes toward Meishuguan Houjie, enjoying the street scenes of Beijing along the way. Upon arriving at Ziguangyuan Roast Duck (Meishuguan Branch), I took a seat and ordered half a roast duck, zhajiang noodles, Qianlong-style cabbage, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. When the roast duck was served, the chef sliced it on the spot, filling the air with its enticing aroma. Ma Xiulan mainly savored the crispy duck skin dipped in sugar and wrapped in pancakes, consciously controlling her portions while eating more vegetables and noodles. The children enjoyed their meal with great relish. The satisfying meal lasted about 1.5 hours.
location: No. 58, Meishuguan Houjie, Dongcheng District, Beijing, Ziguangyuan Roast Duck (Meishuguan Branch)

name: Transportation to the Summer Palace
description: After lunch, considering the long walk to the subway station and everyone's fatigue, my sister used her phone to book a ride-hailing service. We arrived near Xisi Subway Station about 20 minutes later. Then, we took Line 4 and transferred to Line 16 to reach Beigongmen Station of the Summer Palace. The subway journey took about 40 minutes. Ma Xiulan and her sister chatted about their morning experiences at the Forbidden City, while the children were feeling a bit drowsy.
location: Take a taxi from Ziguangyuan Roast Duck Restaurant to Xisi Subway Station, then take the subway to the Beigongmen Station of the Summer Palace.

name: Visit the Summer Palace
description: Entering the Summer Palace from the North Palace Gate, I first visited Suzhou Street, then climbed Longevity Hill, where the scenery of Kunming Lake unfolded before my eyes. Strolling along the Long Corridor, I admired the exquisite painted decorations. Near the Marble Boat, I took a boat to South Lake Island, where a cool breeze blew gently, and the beautiful landscape of the lake and mountains was breathtaking. I felt a rare sense of relaxation and contentment, temporarily forgetting the trivial matters at home. Due to the late hour, I mainly explored the classic areas near the North Palace Gate.
location: Beijing Haidian District, the North Palace Gate of the Summer Palace and within the park

name: Take a taxi back to my sister's house.
description: After leaving the Summer Palace, it was already late in the day. Considering that taking public transportation back would take nearly two hours and everyone was tired, my sister called for a ride-hailing car. We arrived smoothly at the Beikong Residential Community about 50 minutes later. Although it cost some money, we saved time and energy, and everyone felt it was worth it.
location: Take a taxi from the North Palace Gate of the Summer Palace to No. 102 Wudian Road, Beikong Residential Community, Daxing District, Beijing.

name: Assist in preparing and enjoying a homemade dinner.
description: After returning home, despite feeling tired, I took the initiative to help my sister in the kitchen. Dinner consisted of the pork rib soup she had prepared in the morning, along with two stir-fried vegetable dishes and steamed rice. The two families gathered around the table, enjoying the homemade meal while sharing photos and amusing stories from the day, creating a relaxed and cheerful atmosphere.
location: Sister's Kitchen and Dining Room, Beikong Residential Area, No. 102 Wudian Road, Daxing District, Beijing

name: Cleaning up after the meal and having a late-night chat with my sister.
description: After the meal, I quickly tidied up the dishes and kitchen with my sister. Then, we brewed a pot of jasmine tea and settled comfortably on the living room sofa. The children were nearby, watching cartoons or playing with toys. The two sisters engaged in a deep conversation, discussing their parents' health, the joys and challenges of raising their children, and their husbands' work. Ma Xiulan shared her recent accomplishments with her sister, such as learning to shop online, passing the first subject of her driving test, and teaching embroidery in the community. Her sister, in turn, shared snippets of her life in Beijing and her experiences with parenting. Amidst the lingering aroma of tea, the bond between them felt deep and heartfelt, filling them with warmth and contentment.
location: No. 102 Wudian Road, Beikong Residential Area, Daxing District, Beijing, at my sister's living room

name: Urge children to wash up and prepare for bedtime.
description: After the evening chat, I urged my three children to wash up and go to bed one by one. Once the children were settled, I performed a simple wash-up myself. Returning to the guest room, I felt physically exhausted as if my body had fallen apart, yet my spirit was joyful. I prepared the clothes to wear tomorrow, set the alarm, and reflected on the famous sights I had enjoyed today and the heartfelt conversation with my sister. With a sense of fulfillment, warmth, and weariness, I quickly drifted into sleep.
location: No. 102, Wudian Road, Daxing District, Beijing, the bathroom and guest room in my sister's home at the Beikong Residential Community

name: Morning family breakfast and packing up.
description: Ma Xiulan woke up early. Despite the fatigue from yesterday's sightseeing, she remained active on the last day of the holiday. Together with her sister Ma Xiufen, she prepared breakfast in the kitchen, which included millet porridge, boiled eggs, steamed buns, and pickles, while the children had milk. The whole family enjoyed a warm meal together. Afterward, Ma Xiulan urged her three children to check their belongings. She then went through the luggage herself, setting aside the Beijing specialty snacks meant for their neighbor, Sister Wang, preparing for the farewell.
location: At the home of Sister Ma Xiufen in Jiugong Town, Daxing District, Beijing

name: Visit the miniature Great Wall at the World Park.
description: After bidding farewell to her sister’s family, Ma Xiulan walked with her children from her sister’s house to the Jiugong subway station and took the metro to the World Park. On the subway, she handled household matters: replying to a WeChat message from her neighbor Wang Guilan, sending a voice message to her friend Liu Chunmei, and browsing the vegetable market group chat to check the price of green beans. Upon arriving at the World Park, they visited the miniature Great Wall in the Asia section, where she encouraged the children to "climb" it and take photos, experiencing a symbolic journey along the Great Wall. After briefly viewing other miniature structures, they took the metro back to her sister’s house. On the way, she sent a WeChat message to her husband Ma Zhiqiang to inform him of their return time and arrange dinner.
location: No. 158 Dabaotai, Huaxiang, Fengtai District, Beijing World Park, Beijing, China

name: Farewell Lunch and Heartfelt Goodbyes
description: My sister arranged a farewell lunch at an authentic Beijing stewed offal restaurant. Ma Xiulan had lunch with her sister's family and the children, enjoying dishes like stewed offal, fried sausage, and fermented bean curd. Ma Xiulan had a good appetite and ate a bit more than usual. During the meal, the two sisters shared heartfelt words. Ma Xiulan expressed her gratitude for her sister's care and invited them to visit Tianjin. The children were also reluctant to part with their cousins. Before leaving, her sister even packed a bag of fruits for the road.
location: The original Xiaocun Bridge Stewed Intestines (Jiugong Branch) on Wanyuan North Road, Daxing District, Beijing

name: Returning to Tianjin from Beijing
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan and the children took a ride-hailing car to Beijing South Railway Station, encountering some traffic congestion along the way. Upon arriving at the station, they collected their tickets and entered, purchasing bread, yogurt, and other items as simple meals for the high-speed train during the waiting period. They boarded the GXXXX high-speed train from Beijing South Railway Station to Tianjin South Railway Station. During the journey, Ma Xiulan relaxed and rested while the children snacked. Due to the morning activities and travel, Ma Xiulan felt a strong appetite. The high-speed train arrived at Tianjin South Railway Station on schedule, after which they took a taxi home, heading toward Jinghai District.
location: No. 12, Yongwai Street, Fengtai District, Beijing South Railway Station, Beijing

name: Arrive home and settle the luggage.
description: The taxi stopped at the entrance of the residential complex, and Ma Xiulan and the children walked home, feeling a sense of relief as they opened the door. Her husband had not yet returned from work. Ma Xiulan urged the children to take out their clothes, placing those that needed washing into the washing machine. She then put away the things they had brought back, checked the kitchen and refrigerator, and gave everything a quick dusting.
location: At home in the Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu residential community, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Preparation and Enjoyment of Family Dinner
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang bought fresh noodles and ready-to-eat braised beef. Ma Xiulan used the remaining vegetables to prepare a tomato and egg sauce and smashed cucumber salad. Feeling particularly hungry, she intentionally cooked extra noodles. The whole family gathered around the table to enjoy the noodles with sauce. The children shared their experiences from Beijing with their father, while Ma Xiulan, with a hearty appetite, finished a full bowl of noodles along with the braised beef. After the meal, they cleared the dishes, cleaned the kitchen, and supervised the children as they took turns bathing and preparing their clothes for the start of school the next day.
location: At home in Zhongnan Junyuefu, Jinghai District, Ruidao, Tianjin City.

name: Sew the main body of the baby's hat.
description: After settling the children, Ma Xiulan took out the materials for the infant cap she was making for her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin. Using her old sewing machine under the living room light, she focused intently on the stitching. With practiced ease, she sewed the fleece pieces together to form the main body of the cap, all while listening to the background sounds of a TV drama. Once that was done, she decided to leave the more intricate tasks of hemming and adding decorations for the following day.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, living room at home

name: Pre-sleep hygiene and bedtime.
description: After finishing her washing, Ma Xiulan lay in bed with her husband for a late-night chat, sharing details of her trip to Beijing and discussing plans for the next few days, such as preparing school supplies for their son and grocery shopping at the market. Feeling tired yet content and at ease, she drifted off to sleep.
location: In the bedroom of Jinghai Zhongnan Junyue Mansion on Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Packing up and saying goodbye at my sister's home in Beijing in the early morning.
description: Having breakfast with my sister's family, packing up, and placing the unfinished baby hat in the bag. Saying goodbye to my sister and nephews, thanking them for their hospitality, and making plans to meet again next time, the atmosphere was warm yet tinged with reluctance.
location: At the home of the elder sister in a residential community in Fengtai District, Beijing

name: The journey from Beijing back to home in Jinghai, Tianjin.
description: My sister drove Ma Xiulan to Beijing South Railway Station, with slightly congested traffic during the morning rush hour. After arriving, they waited for the train and went through ticket inspection, during which she sent a WeChat message to her husband to inform him of the journey. They took the high-speed train from Beijing South to Tianjin South, enjoying the scenery outside the window and taking a short nap along the way. Upon arriving at Tianjin South Station, they transferred to Metro Line 3 and took a bus or taxi back home to Zhongnan Junyuefu in Jinghai District.
location: From my sister's home in Fengtai District, Beijing, to Beijing South Railway Station, then via the GXXX high-speed train to Tianjin South Railway Station, and finally returning to the Ruihé Dào Jinghǎi Zhōngnán Jūnyuèfǔ residential community in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Arranging luggage, lunch, afternoon rest, and contacting family.
description: After returning home, I opened the windows for ventilation, unpacked the luggage, and washed the clothes. I used leftover rice to make a simple egg fried rice and tomato egg soup for lunch. I took a nap for about 40 minutes. Upon waking up, I contacted my mother to let her know I was safe and shared some stories from my time in Beijing. I also sent a message to my husband to inform him that I had settled in.
location: At home in Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Community, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Complete the embroidery of the baby hat.
description: In the living room at home, with a TV drama playing in the background, I focused on finishing the hemming of the baby hat and carefully embroidered a red "福" character on the front. After completing it, I checked the work, took a photo, and sent it to my craft friend Zhou Xiuqin, informing her that the gift was ready and could be picked up at any time.
location: At the living room of Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Community, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City

name: Go out to purchase ingredients and buy a schoolbag.
description: Ride an electric bike to the Taian Shengshijun Vegetable Market to purchase dinner ingredients, including winter melon, pork ribs, leafy greens, and tomatoes, in preparation for adjusting to a healthier diet; then detour to a stationery store near the Jinghai Wanda Yufu Shijia commercial area to select a black, simple, and durable backpack for the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan; finally, ride the bike back home.
location: From Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Community to Yuewei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Taian Shengshijun Vegetable Market, then to the shops around Jinghai Wanda Yufu Shijia, and finally returning home.

name: Handling household chores and preparing dinner
description: After putting away the purchased ingredients, I began preparing dinner: blanching the pork ribs, cutting the winter melon into chunks, and washing and soaking the vegetables. At the same time, I hung the freshly washed clothes from the washing machine on the balcony, making preparations for the evening cooking.
location: In the kitchen and balcony of the home in the Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu residential complex on Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Go out to take out the trash and try square dancing.
description: Sorting out the household waste, I headed to the Chunxi Road waste transfer station in the residential area. While passing by the central open space, I unexpectedly ran into my neighbors Wang Guilan and Zhang Shufen dancing to square dance music. Encouraged by their enthusiasm, I joined in for the first time, clumsily swaying my body to the rhythm. In the relaxed atmosphere, I gradually let go and felt a sense of joy.
location: Within the Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City, at the Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Community (specifically at the Chunxi Road Garbage Transfer Station and the central open space)

name: Cooking a healthy dinner and having it with the whole family.
description: Returning home to cook a light winter melon and pork rib soup, garlic stir-fried greens, and mixed grain rice, practicing healthy eating; the whole family sat together for dinner, Ma Xiulan shared amusing stories and clumsy moments from trying square dancing, her husband and children found it fresh and interesting, while also letting their eldest son Ma Mingxuan try on the new backpack. The dinner was warm and pleasant.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Home Chinese Restaurant

name: Tidying up the kitchen and supervising the children's studies.
description: Clearing the dishes and cleaning the kitchen; at the same time, supervising the second son Ma Mingzhe to complete his homework, checking the daughter Ma Yuxin's pinyin practice, while the eldest son Ma Mingxuan reviews on his own, and the husband rests in the living room, maintaining a family learning atmosphere.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, kitchen and living room at home.

name: Analyzing Driving Test Wrong Answers and Planning the Renovation of Old Items for the Eldest Son
description: Under the living room lamp, I reviewed the driving test materials and the error notebook, focusing on sorting out confusing traffic signs and regulations, and reorganizing them with notes. After that, I prepared for my eldest son's boarding school by taking out an old cotton mattress, measuring its size, and planning how to cut and sew a mattress cover to transform it into a practical dormitory mattress. This approach is both cost-effective and environmentally friendly.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruhe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, living room and storage room at home.

name: Personal Washing and Going to Bed
description: After urging the children to sleep, I washed up myself; lying in bed, I reviewed the day: returning from Beijing to complete a handicraft project, trying square dancing, family reunion, advancing driving test review and boarding school preparations; the scale showed 55.3 kilograms, with initial success in healthy eating, gradually falling asleep with the excitement of trying new things and the comfort of returning to routine.
location: In the bedroom of Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, Ruidao, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Morning activities and morning exercises
description: After getting up, Ma Xiulan weighed herself (55.1 kilograms), performed her personal hygiene routine, and then engaged in morning exercises, including practicing Baduanjin and brisk walking in the residential area. During the walk, she encountered her neighbor Wang Guilan, inquired about the timing of square dancing, and decided to incorporate it into her regular activities.
location: At home and on internal roads of Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Community, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Breakfast Preparation and Family Breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan prepared breakfast, which included millet porridge, steamed buns, twisted rolls, pickles, and poached eggs. The whole family had breakfast together, and she reminded the children to check their school bags. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, went to school on his own.
location: In the kitchen and dining room of the home at Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Area, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Send the child to school
description: Ma Xiulan first rode her electric bike to take her second son Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and then took her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Area to Jinghai District Third Primary School to Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Morning housework and neighborhood interactions
description: Considering the possibility of afternoon thunderstorms, Ma Xiulan first went to the community vegetable garden to water and inspect the vegetables. She then walked to the tobacco and liquor store (Zhang Shufen Supermarket) in Haixinyuan Community to buy soy sauce. While there, she chatted with the store owner, Zhang Shufen, seeking advice on preparing for her child's boarding school life and received practical suggestions. Afterward, she walked back home to tidy up.

name: Heading back to the hospital to prepare for overnight care.

She fed her father some pork rib soup, then proceeded with intensive rehabilitation care: she helped her father lie on his side, performed back percussion for about 25 minutes to assist him in expelling phlegm, and cleaned up afterward. After discussing her father's condition with the nurse, she stayed overnight to watch over him as he slept, adjusting her own tired body and sending messages to her husband. She decided to stay in the hospital overnight, resting on the accompanying chair, waking up multiple times to check on her father, and barely managing to close her eyes until nearly one in the morning.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Ward, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District

name: Waking up in the morning and checking on mother.
description: Worried about my father and suffering from back pain, I barely slept all night and got up to wash at 5:45. I checked on my mother, who was lying on the sofa in the living room with her clothes on, inquired about my father's condition during the night, and then urged my mother to go home and rest.
location: Tianjin City, Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, bedroom and living room at home.

name: Buy breakfast and remind family members.
date: From 06:10:00 on September 16, 2025, to 06:40:00 on September 16, 2025.
description: After taking money from home, I went to the breakfast stall at the entrance of the community to buy steamed buns, soy milk, and tea eggs. Upon returning home, I set up the breakfast, woke up the children, and reminded them to stay safe and follow the after-school arrangements. My husband, Ma Zhiqiang, prepared to leave for work and comforted her before heading out.
location: Breakfast stall at the entrance of Zhongnan Junyuefu Community on Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City, and at home

name: Riding an electric bike to the hospital.
