name: Assist father with breakfast, medication, and morning care.
description: After waking up, I helped my father sit up halfway and fed him the millet porridge we had brought. After the meal, I assisted him in taking his morning medication. Then, I used warm water to wipe his face and wash his hands. My father seemed a bit more energetic and asked about the children.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department, Respiratory Medicine Ward

name: Observation and treatment, implementation of nursing care, and communication with doctors.
description: The nurse came to hang the infusion bottle, and Ma Xiulan observed the infusion speed and her father's reactions, recording them in a notebook. When the attending doctor made rounds, she proactively inquired about the monitoring data, treatment priorities, and sputum expulsion. The doctor advised continuing with back percussion for sputum expulsion, after which she performed about 15 minutes of back percussion care for her father.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department, Respiratory Medicine Ward and Nurse Station

name: Call the eldest child's homeroom teacher to discuss academic progress.
description: While my father was asleep, I went to the stairwell to call Mr. Han, the homeroom teacher of my eldest son, Xuanxuan. I inquired about the specific details of the notice in the parent group chat. Mr. Han mentioned that Xuanxuan has been in a stable state recently but seemed a bit quiet. Ma Xiulan explained the family situation, thanked the teacher for his concern, and expressed that she would pay attention to the child's emotions.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department Stairwell

name: Continue with companionship and manually adjust emotions.
description: Father was sound asleep, so Ma Xiulan took out her embroidery materials to work on a crabapple flower pattern, hoping to calm her nerves. From time to time, she checked the IV drip and the monitor. After embroidering for about half an hour, her eyes grew tired, so she put away her work and stretched her back.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department, Respiratory Medicine Ward

name: Assist father with lunch and quickly have a meal and rest on my own.
description: After waking up, the father was fed the liquid lunch provided by the hospital. Following that, Ma Xiulan quickly had her own lunch in the corridor rest area, consisting of steamed buns, boiled eggs, and pickled vegetables. After the meal, she rested with her eyes closed for about 20 minutes while keeping an ear out for any activity in the ward.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department, Respiratory Medicine Ward and Corridor Rest Area

name: Afternoon Care: Assisting with Activities and Providing Companionship through Conversation
description: After his afternoon nap, Father felt a bit better, and Ma Xiulan helped him walk slowly around the ward to stretch his limbs. Later, she chatted with him, reminiscing about the fun times when the children were young. During breaks in their conversation, she updated her husband and mother on Father’s condition via WeChat. When the afternoon intravenous drip began, Father fell asleep again, and she kept an eye on him while doing some handicrafts.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department, Respiratory Medicine Ward

name: Check community group messages and thank the neighbors.
description: Check the WeChat group "Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Handicraft Corner" on your phone to discuss the Mid-Autumn Festival activities. Edit a thank-you message to Aunt Wang Guilan next door for the soup she sent yesterday. Sister Wang replies, asking her to focus on taking care of the elderly.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department, Respiratory Medicine Ward

name: Hand over duties to mother in the evening and assist father with dinner.
description: Mother came to take over with a thermal bucket in hand. Ma Xiulan gave a detailed account of the daytime situation, medication, and nursing precautions. She assisted Father in eating the soft, well-cooked noodles brought by Mother. Seeing that Father’s condition was stable, she decided to go home to prepare dinner for the children.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department, Respiratory Medicine Ward

name: Riding an electric scooter home and picking up groceries along the way.
description: I left the hospital on an electric scooter and stopped at the Taian Shengshijun vegetable market on the way home to quickly buy tomatoes, eggs, greens, and fresh noodles. The vendor asked about my father's condition with concern. After that, I continued riding the electric scooter for about 5 minutes to get home.
location: From the inpatient department of Jinghai District Hospital in Jinghai District, Tianjin, to the Taian Shengshijun Vegetable Market on Yuewei Road in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and then to Jinghai Zhongnan Junyue Mansion on Ruihe Road in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Go home to prepare dinner, have dinner with the children, and do the subsequent housework.
description: After arriving home, I tied on an apron to prepare dinner, making tomato and egg sauce, blanching vegetables, and boiling noodles. I called the children to wash their hands and eat, asking about their day at school during the meal, paying special attention to my eldest son's mood. After dinner, I quickly cleaned up the kitchen and dishes, urged my second son to do his homework, checked my eldest son's assignments, and played puzzles with my youngest daughter. During this time, my husband called to say he would be home later.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruhe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, kitchen, dining room, and living room at home.

name: Organize items and prepare to return to the hospital.
description: Check the room needed for father after discharge, consider adding soft cushions. Pack the items to be taken to the hospital tomorrow in advance. Send a WeChat message to mother informing her of return to the hospital in about an hour.
location: At home in Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City

name: Riding an electric bike back to the hospital.
description: Riding an electric bike to the hospital in the night, I tightened my coat, thinking that tonight would be another night requiring vigilance and care.
location: From Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, Jinghai District, Tianjin City to the Inpatient Department of Jinghai District Hospital, Jinghai District, Tianjin City

name: Nighttime Care Handover, Nursing, and Guarding
description: Returning to the ward to take over the evening care, I assisted my father with rinsing his mouth and trying to expel phlegm. I let my mother rest on the accompanying chair. Sitting by the bedside, I held my father's hand and spoke softly until he fell asleep. During the night, I turned off the main light, leaving only the wall lamp on. Fighting off drowsiness, I kept an eye on the monitor and my father. Whenever he coughed, I immediately got up to pat his back and offer him water. It was nearly one in the morning before I leaned back in the chair, half-asleep and half-awake, remaining vigilant and watchful.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department, Respiratory Medicine Ward

name: Hospital Morning Accompanying and Nursing
description: Waking up on the caregiver's chair in the respiratory ward of Jinghai District Hospital in the early morning, Ma Xiulan felt a sore throat and chills throughout her body. After taking her temperature, she discovered she had a low-grade fever. She first took care of herself by soothing her throat with warm water, then quietly assisted her father with his morning routine. After the nurse delivered breakfast, she patiently fed her father and supervised his medication. When the attending physician made rounds and informed her that her father's condition was stable, she carefully noted the instructions. During her father's intravenous drip, she continued to provide attentive care, wiping him with a damp towel while also contacting her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, via WeChat to remind him to take their child to school and inquire about her mother's shift handover time. After her father's IV session ended, she helped him move slowly, and feeling dizzy from her cold, she closed her eyes to rest for a moment.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital, Department of Respiratory Medicine Ward

name: Telephone Consultation with Community Doctors
description: While her father was taking a break, Ma Xiulan walked to the stairwell of the hospital inpatient department and called Dr. Wang from the Chaoyang Street Community Hospital in Jinghai District. She described her cold symptoms in detail, such as a sore throat and low-grade fever. Dr. Wang suggested taking Compound Ganmaoling Granules, drinking plenty of warm water, and resting, and advised seeking medical attention if the fever worsened. After thanking Dr. Wang, Ma Xiulan felt somewhat relieved.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department Stairwell

name: Hand over the shift with mother and ride the electric bike home.
description: Li Xiuying, the mother, arrived at the hospital to take over the shift. Ma Xiulan carefully explained her father's condition, the doctor's instructions, and the time for the next medication, handing over the empty lunchbox brought from home to her mother. Afterward, she put on her raincoat, got on her electric bike, and left the hospital. With a light drizzle falling, she rode slowly, arriving home about 25 minutes later.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital, Jinghai District

name: Handling neighborly assistance, household chores, and rest at home.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan saw the insulated soup container and fresh vegetables left in the kitchen by her neighbor, Wang Guilan. She first boiled water and, following the community doctor’s advice, dissolved a packet of cold medicine granules. Then, she thoroughly washed and dried the soup container before taking it to Sister Wang’s house across the hall to express her sincere gratitude. The two exchanged a brief conversation at the door, during which Sister Wang inquired with concern about her father’s and her own health. After returning the container, she quickly washed the dishes and utensils left by her family and wiped down the kitchen counter. Though she had no appetite, to replenish her energy, she used the vegetables from her neighbor to cook a simple bowl of vegetarian noodles. While cooking, she replied to a WeChat message from her younger sister, Xiufen, who was asking about their father’s condition. After finishing the noodles and tidying up, a wave of exhaustion washed over her, leading her to take a short half-hour nap on the living room sofa. Upon waking, her dizziness had slightly subsided, so she began preparing ingredients for dinner in advance: thawing the spare ribs from the refrigerator, peeling and cutting potatoes into chunks, and soaking them in water. She then gave the living room a quick clean-up, putting away scattered toys.
location: At home in Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu Residential Community, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Pay attention to the father's condition and personal rest.
description: I sent a WeChat message to my mother to ask about my father's condition at noon. After learning that everything was fine, I felt relieved. During this time, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa, drank more hot water, and browsed the chat in the community handicraft corner's WeChat group (discussing Mid-Autumn Festival activities) on her phone. However, due to a cold, she had no energy to participate. She rested quietly to let her body regain strength.
location: At home in the Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu residential community, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Pick up and drop off children from school and supervise their studies.
description: After the rain stopped, the sky remained overcast. Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, from school. Around 14:30, she picked up Xinxin, who excitedly shared fun stories from kindergarten. On the way home, she stopped by the Hai Xinyuan Community tobacco and liquor store at the entrance of the residential area to buy a bottle of vinegar. After arriving home, she washed Xinxin’s hands and face and gave her some fruit to eat. Once settled, she rode her electric bike again to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son, Ma Mingzhe, from school. At 15:30, she picked up Zhe Zhe and returned home, where she urged him to wash his hands and start his homework. While keeping an eye on Xinxin as she played, Ma Xiulan checked Zhe Zhe’s math homework and corrected careless mistakes. During this time, her eldest son, Ma Xuanxuan, returned home from school.
location: At home in the Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu residential community, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Preparing dinner, family dining, and post-meal cleanup.
description: Ma Xiulan began preparing dinner: she stewed the pork ribs and potatoes prepared at noon, stir-fried some green vegetables, and her eldest son Xuanxuan helped cook the rice. The dinner was simple but warm. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, returned home after finishing his driving shift, and the family gathered around the table to eat. Ma Xiulan had little appetite, eating only some vegetables and drinking soup. She explained to her husband about her father’s condition and her own slight recovery from a cold, and informed him that she needed to return to the hospital that evening, asking him to supervise the children’s homework and bedtime. After the meal, she quickly tidied up the kitchen, packed her father’s clean clothes, her own water bottle, charger, an extra coat for her mother, and some fruit into a cloth bag. Before leaving, she reminded the children once more, and her husband urged her to be careful on the way.
location: At home in the Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu residential community, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Riding an electric bike back to the hospital.
description: Riding an electric scooter from home towards Jinghai District Hospital, the sky gradually darkened, and the evening breeze turned chilly. She tightened her coat. After about 30 minutes, she arrived at the hospital, parked, and walked toward the inpatient department.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Jinghai District Hospital

name: Overnight Hospital Accompaniment and Self-Recovery
description: Ma Xiulan arrived at the respiratory medicine ward of the hospital, where her mother was taking care of her father. She asked her mother to rest and have some fruit, then took over the caregiving duties herself. She inquired in detail about her father’s condition in the afternoon, assisted him with his evening washing and taking medication, and chatted with him about everyday matters. After her father fell asleep, the ward grew quiet. Ma Xiulan felt extremely exhausted, and the drowsiness from the cold medicine began to set in. She sat quietly on the caregiver’s chair, holding her father’s hand, occasionally tucking in the blanket. Closing her eyes, she reflected on the day’s events, her heart filled with gratitude. When her father coughed during the night, she woke up immediately to attend to him. After that, she drifted in and out of sleep, caught between exhaustion and discomfort, until she finally fell into a deep slumber a little after one in the morning.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital, Department of Respiratory Medicine, Inpatient Ward

name: Waking Up in the Hospital and Self-Care
date: From 05:30:00 on September 18, 2025, to 06:00:00 on September 18, 2025.
description: Waking up on the stiff hospital chair, she felt sore all over, her nose so congested that she could only breathe through her mouth, and her head heavy as if filled with lead. Groping in the dark, she poured herself a cup of hot water and took the cold medicine she had gotten from Dr. Wang at the community clinic the day before. Softly, she asked her father, "Dad, did you cough during the night? How did you sleep?" Learning that he was stable, she felt a little more at ease. Her mother had also woken up, and the two of them exchanged a few whispered words in the faint light seeping in from the corridor.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department, Respiratory Medicine Ward, Shengli Street, Jinghai District

name: Assist with morning care and handover for father.
description: She wiped her father's face and hands with warm water. Her mother poured some millet congee from a thermos that she had prepared at home, and Ma Xiulan helped raise the head of the hospital bed, watching as her mother patiently fed her father spoonful by spoonful. She herself had little appetite and only managed to drink half a glass of water. When it was time to hand over the care, she explained in a hoarse voice, "He took his medicine at two in the morning, drank water three times, and didn’t cough much during the latter half of the night. Dr. Wang said this cold medicine should be taken three times a day—I’ve put it all in this drawer." After speaking, she couldn’t help but turn away and cough a few times.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department, Respiratory Medicine Ward, Victory Avenue, Jinghai District

name: Riding an electric bike back home.
description: She put on her coat, wrapped a scarf around her neck, and rode her small electric scooter away from the hospital. The early morning streets were shrouded in a gray haze, and the chilly wind crept into her collar, making her hunch her shoulders. With few cars and pedestrians on the road, she rode slower than usual, and after about 25 minutes, she arrived back at the familiar neighborhood.
location: From Jinghai District Hospital to the home at Jinghai Zhongnan Junyue Mansion, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and waking up the children.
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang left for work before dawn. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was already washing up on his own. Ma Xiulan mustered her energy, took frozen buns and steamed buns from the fridge to steam, while cooking millet porridge in a small pot and frying a few sunny-side-up eggs. Coughing intermittently, she went to wake up her second son, Zhe Zhe, and her youngest daughter, Xin Xin: "Zhe Zhe, Xin Xin, get up quickly! You'll be late for school if you don't hurry!" At the dining table, she watched the children eat, only drinking half a small bowl of porridge herself before taking another dose of cold medicine, feeling as though something was stuck in her throat.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruhe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, kitchen, living room, bedroom at home

name: Take the child to school
description: First, take my youngest daughter Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (about a 5-minute bike ride). At the entrance, I met Teacher Li and said in a hoarse voice, "Teacher Li, could you please keep an eye on Xinxin and make sure she drinks more water? I have a cold and I'm afraid of passing it on." Then, I took my second son, Zhe Zhe, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (about an 8-minute bike ride). Watching him skip and run into the school gate, I finally breathed a sigh of relief. My eldest son, Mingxuan, had already ridden his bicycle to school on his own.
location: From Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, Jinghai District, Tianjin City, to Huakang First Kindergarten on Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City, and then to Jinghai District Third Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin City

name: Quick Shopping at the Vegetable Market
date: From 08:20:00 on September 18, 2025, to 08:50:00 on September 18, 2025.
description: After dropping off the child, she rode to the familiar Taian Shengshijun Vegetable Market (about a 5-minute ride). Feeling dizzy and lightheaded, she headed straight to her usual stall, where she bought tomatoes, eggs, a bunch of bok choy, and a bundle of thin noodles, planning to make the simplest tomato and egg noodle soup for dinner. Seeing her pale face, the vendor, Sister Liu, asked with concern, “Xiulan, what’s wrong? You look so unwell.” Ma Xiulan forced a smile and replied, “It’s nothing, just a cold. My dad is still in the hospital.” Sister Liu quickly said, “Oh, that must be tough. You should hurry back and rest.”
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Yuewei Road Taian Shengshijun Vegetable Market

name: Walking home and putting things away
description: Carrying the groceries, she walked about 15 minutes home from the market. After arriving, she put the vegetables and eggs in the refrigerator and stored the noodles. Feeling a sudden wave of dizziness and exhaustion, she knew she had to rest.
location: From the Yuewei Road Taian Shengshijun Vegetable Market in Jinghai District, Tianjin, to the home at Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu on Ruihe Road in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Mandatory Rest and Contact with Craft Friends
description: After simply rinsing the breakfast dishes, I could no longer hold on. I poured a large glass of hot water, wrapped myself in a sofa blanket, and lay down. I had intended to watch the morning news, but my eyelids were too heavy to lift, and I soon dozed off to the sound of the television. I slept for about half an hour before being woken by a coughing fit. Though my spirits were slightly better, my throat felt even hoarser. She picked up her phone and sent a long voice message to her craft friend, Zhou Xiuqin: "Sister Xiuqin, I’m really sorry… My father is in the hospital, and my cold has gotten worse. That embroidery work of yours… I’m afraid it’ll be a few days late. I’m truly sorry…" Not long after, Zhou Xiuqin replied with a voice message, full of understanding.
location: In the living room of Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, Ruidao, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Simple Lunch Preparation and Consumption
description: She had no appetite, but an empty stomach left her even weaker. She boiled a small handful of noodles, poached an egg in the clear broth, and forced herself to eat it with a bit of fermented tofu. While eating, the WeChat group for the community handicraft corner kept flashing on her phone, but she didn’t have the energy to open it.
location: Kitchen and dining room in Jinghai Zhongnan Junyue Mansion, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City

name: Return the soup pot and thank the neighbor.
description: Carefully washing the ceramic pot that Wang Guilan had used to deliver soup yesterday, she placed it in a clean cloth bag and went across the hall. Wang Guilan opened the door and, seeing her pale complexion, quickly pulled her inside. "Oh, Xiulan, you look so pale... come in and sit down!" Ma Xiulan didn’t enter, standing at the doorway and saying sincerely, "Sister Wang, thank you so much for yesterday! That soup and the dishes were a lifesaver—my dad even said how delicious it was. I’ve been hit hard by this cold and didn’t get a chance to thank you properly." Wang Guilan patted her hand. "No need to thank me! That’s what neighbors are for. Is your dad feeling better? You should take care of yourself—if it gets worse, go see a doctor at the community clinic." The two exchanged a few heartfelt words at the door.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Opposite to Jinghai Zhongnan Junyue Mansion (Wang Guilan's Home)

name: Lunch Break and Organizing Thoughts
description: Returning to her cold, empty home, the weariness washed over her once more. She decided to lie down properly in bed for a while. Setting the alarm for 12:30, she took out the tomatoes she would need for the evening and placed them in the kitchen. Lying in bed, her body was exhausted, but her mind refused to settle: Had her father received his afternoon injection? Would Zhe Zhe finish his homework quickly tonight? When would her cold finally get better? Her thoughts were a jumble, and though she didn’t truly fall asleep, she allowed her body a brief moment of rest in the stillness of lying down.
location: In the bedroom of the home at Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Riding an electric bike to the hospital.
description: The alarm clock rang, and I struggled to get out of bed. I splashed cold water on my face in an attempt to wake up, but it had little effect. Putting on a thick coat, I grabbed my water bottle and two apples for my mother, then rode my electric scooter back to the hospital (a ride of about 25 minutes).
location: From home at Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu on Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District Hospital on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Hospital afternoon accompaniment
description: Arriving at the ward, she found her father had just woken up from his nap. Her mother was busy tidying up. "Mom, you should go home and rest, have a warm meal. I’ll take over here," she urged her mother to leave. During the afternoon care, she tried to "conserve her energy": she helped her father raise the hospital bed, fed him water, and ensured he took his medicine on time. She gently wiped his hands and face with a warm towel. When her father expressed a desire to listen to opera, she found the opera channel and lowered the volume. For most of the time, she sat quietly in the caregiver’s chair, answering her father’s questions when he asked, occasionally closing her eyes to rest. Whenever a nurse entered to check his temperature and blood pressure, she quickly stood up to help record the readings. Throughout the afternoon, she fetched hot water several times for both herself and her father.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Hospital Inpatient Department, Respiratory Medicine Ward, Shengli Street, Jinghai District

name: Pick up the child from school and go home.
description: After telling her father she would return the next day, she left the hospital early. First, she rode to Jinghai District Third Primary School to pick up Zhe Zhe (about a 15-minute ride), then to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Xin Xin (about an 8-minute ride). After picking up the two children, she reminded Zhe Zhe, "Go home and finish your homework quickly. Mom isn’t feeling well today, so don’t dawdle." She then asked Xin Xin if she had a good day at kindergarten. After that, she rode straight home with the two children (about a 7-minute ride).
location: From Jinghai District Hospital on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District Third Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then to Huakang First Kindergarten on Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and finally returning home to Jinghai Zhongnan Junyue Mansion on Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing to have dinner together
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang wouldn't be home for dinner that evening. She tied on her apron and began preparing the meal: stir-fried tomato and egg sauce, boiling water for noodles, and blanching the baby bok choy along the way. Although she felt dizzy and unsteady, years of experience as a homemaker had turned her movements almost into instinct, still orderly and methodical. During dinner, the family of four sat around the table. She served herself only a small half-bowl of noodles, barely touching her chopsticks, mainly watching the children eat. "Xuanxuan, anything interesting happen at school today?" "Zhezhe, eat more vegetables. After dinner, rest for ten minutes and then start your homework. You must finish it before nine today—no more dragging it out until midnight. Mom really doesn’t have the energy anymore." Her tone was weary but firm. Zhezhe glanced at his mother’s exhausted face and obediently nodded.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, kitchen and dining room at home.

name: Supervising homework and taking care of the little daughter
description: First, I took my younger daughter Xinxin to wash up, then told her a short story called "The Little Horse Crosses the River" and coaxed her to sleep. After that, I sat on the living room sofa with a glass of water and medicine in front of me, and began to "supervise" Zhe Zhe as he did his homework. My eldest son Mingxuan’s homework required a parent’s signature, so I mustered my energy to carefully review it and signed it. When Zhe Zhe got stuck on a math problem, I explained it in a hoarse voice, repeatedly emphasizing, "Read the question carefully. Think about how the teacher explained it?" Throughout the process, I coughed constantly and got up several times to drink water. Compared to yesterday’s impatience, today was more about persistence fueled by exhaustion.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Ruihe Road, Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu, living room and children's room at home.

name: Children's Bedtime Preparation and Personal Hygiene
description: It was almost nine o'clock when Zhe Zhe finally finished his main homework. Ma Xiulan checked it over and found few mistakes, so she told him to pack up his schoolbag and get ready for bed. She then urged the three children to take turns washing up. She herself soaked her feet thoroughly in hot water, feeling a slight relief in her icy toes and aching calves, before quickly brushing her teeth and washing her face.
location: In the bathroom and bedroom of the home at Jinghai Zhongnan Junyuefu on Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin City.

name: Brief relaxation and bedtime
description: The house was finally completely quiet. She sat on the edge of the bed, intending to check her phone or watch TV, but overwhelming drowsiness and discomfort throughout her body made her give up.
